companies.name: Heat Doward
companies.distributes: Pharmacy health, beauty and accessories with a confectionery line: hard sweets and fruit drops (Simpkins Drops) and ginger confectionery (Buderim Ginger) as exclusive Australian distributor; Pharmacy Daily also reported Kelly Candy Co, Vivil, Go Natural, Dollar Sweets and Munch sweets and snacks in its pharmacy range.
companies.channels_supplied: Community pharmacies across Australia, plus supermarkets and chain stores.
companies.sf_brands_carried: Vivil (sugar-free sweets) as reported by Pharmacy Daily; no direct Diablo competitor seen on its brands page.
companies.fit_rationale: Heat Doward calls itself a partner in pharmacy and is the exclusive Australian distributor for Simpkins Drops and Buderim Ginger, so packaged sweets are already a line it sells to pharmacies. Diablo's sugar-free sweets, chocolate and bars suit its pharmacy confectionery offer and its rep-led service. Scale: more than 500 pharmacies across Australia (Pharmacy Daily) and Doward alone had over 6,000 trade clients, about 80% of them pharmacies (SmartCompany). Storage: exclusive Australian distributor that buys the brands and wholesales them to its trade clients; a warehouse address was not seen on the pages read.
what_they_do_well: Pharmacy retail managers rated its sales reps, head office support, brand range and margins above 4 out of 5 in a customer survey.
Doward, now part of Heat Doward, traded for 96 years with about 80% of sales in pharmacy.
